messages:
Ben Harper: FYI incoming SIG + short intake from QP Financial. They want BYOK and KMS integration details before signing POC SOW. Need owner + triage timeline. Doc link: https://files.redwood/qp/sig-qp-2026.pdf
Aisha Patel: Thanks Ben. Contact is laura@qpfin.com; procurement said theyd like SOC2 evidence + KMS flow diagram. I put this in intake RV-3478.
Claire Nguyen: I can take RV-3478. Quick clarifying Qs: will the POC process any regulated data? and do they need external KMS for the POC or only for prod?
Ben Harper: POC will use synthetic/sample trading data, not regulated PHI. They say prod requires BYOK, procurement asked if POC can proceed w/out it for now.
Samir Rao: Note: Hosted API does not support customer-managed KMS. Options: (1) proceed hosted (no BYOK) for POC, (2) Dedicated with KMS integration, (3) Private VPC deployment. Dedicated/Private require legal addendum + infra onboarding (~2-3 weeks).
Claire Nguyen: Okay. I'll answer SIG sections and mark KMS questions as "requires architecture/legal decision". Action list: Claire fill SIG (encryption, key mgmt, access control), Samir to provide infra note on KMS feasibility and estimated delta, Aisha to confirm with procurement whether POC can accept hosted caveat. Target triage: 72h.
Aisha Patel: I pinged Laura and told her we can start the POC on hosted w/ caveat that prod BYOK requires Dedicated/Private. She asked for a pricing bump estimate now so they can budget.
Samir Rao: Ballpark estimate: Dedicated + KMS integration = ~$18k/mo plus one-time onboarding $30k. Will confirm in RV-3478 by EOD.
Claire Nguyen: Adding preliminary SIG answers to ticket. Snippet for encryption and keys:
```
- At-rest: AES-256 (provider-managed keys by default)
- In-transit: TLS1.2+
- BYOK/external KMS: Not supported on Redwood Hosted; supported on Dedicated/Private with HSM/KMS integration and customer key import where required
- Evidence: SOC2 Type II, network diagram, KMS architecture note
```
Aisha Patel: That reads well. I'll tell procurement they can kick off the POC if they sign the POC SOW with the hosted caveat. If they insist on BYOK for POC, we need to switch to dedicated and pause until legal/infra confirm.
Ben Harper: Can we fast-track a minimal KMS note to share with the customer? A plain-language explanation of the difference and timeline would help procurement decide.
Samir Rao: I'll draft a 1-page KMS FAQ and timeline by 5pm today and attach to RV-3478. It will include typical onboarding steps, estimated lead time, and cost impact.
sec-bot: Ticket RV-3478 created and assigned to security-review queue. SLA: triage within 72h. Link: https://tickets.redwood/RV-3478 :white_check_mark:
Claire Nguyen: Marking RV-3478 as in-progress. I'll finish the remaining SIG sections tomorrow AM and attach SOC2/network diagram references once Aisha uploads them.
Aisha Patel: Uploading SOC2 (redacted) and network diagram to RV-3478 now. Laura acknowledged receipt and will confirm POC caveat by EOD.
Ben Harper: Thanks all. Tag me when the SOC2 and KMS FAQ are attached so I can update the opportunity notes for AE. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: RV-3478 updated: owner=Claire Nguyen; priority=High; due=2824079999
Claire Nguyen: Will do. I'll post final SIG answers and required evidence checklist when complete.
Ben Harper: Appreciate the quick turnaround team, this one looks like a close.
